eni.translation: abbr. Equivalent Noise Input 等效噪音输入

eniac.translation: abbr. 电子数字积分计算机, ENIAC计算机（Electronic Numerical Integrator And Calculator）

enid.definition: n. a town in north central Oklahoma
enid.translation: n. 伊妮德（女子名）；伊尼德（美国一城市）

enigma.definition:
n something that baffles understanding and cannot be explained
n a difficult problem
enigma.translation: n. 谜, 费解的事物

enigmas.translation: n. 难于理解的问题、人、物、情况等, 奥秘( enigma的名词复数 )

enigmatic.definition:
s. not clear to the understanding
s. resembling an oracle in obscurity of thought
enigmatic.translation: a. 费解的, 谜一般的, 高深莫测的

enigmatical.definition: s not clear to the understanding
enigmatical.translation: a. 难解的, 谜一般的, 不可思议的

enigmatically.translation: adv. 莫名其妙地, 难以理解地

enigmatize.definition: v. i. To make, or talk in, enigmas; to deal in riddles.
enigmatize.translation: vt. 使成谜, 使费解

enigmatizing.definition: p. pr. & vb. n. of Enigmatize

enisei.translation: n. 叶尼塞河(西伯利亚中部河流)

enisle.translation: vt. 使成岛, 置于岛上, 使孤立

enisled.definition:
p. a. Placed alone or apart, as if on an island; severed, as
   an island.
enisled.translation: v. 使成岛, 使孤立, 置于岛上( enisle的过去式和过去分词 )

enit.translation: abbr. Ente Nazionale Industrie Turistiche (Italian=National Tourist Industry) （意大利语）国家旅游业; Ente Nazionale Intaliano per il Turismo 意大利国家旅游局

eniwetok.definition:
n an atoll in the Marshall Islands; site of an amphibious assault in World War II; later used temporarily by the United States to test atomic bombs
n World War II (February 1944); American infantry landed and captured a Japanese stronghold
eniwetok.translation: 埃尼威托克岛[西太平洋]
